_about: Rows of tests/test_guard_bypass.py whose command pipes echo into a shell or an interpreter. They are test data the propose guard must refuse. They live here because Hermes' plugin scanner reads such a line in a .py file as runnable code (echo_pipe_exec); in a data file under fixtures/ it reads it as test data. {OK_P} and {OVER_P} are filled in from the constants of the same name in tests/test_guard_bypass.py.
